integrity: The nonexistence proof uses Alderson's published shortening structure and Noda's published classification of Rao-tight strength-3 orthogonal arrays. The binary existence case is independently replayable.
scientific_limitations: The result treats exact length maximality only, with \(k=4\) and \(s=q-1\); it does not address the separate \(s=q-2\) branch or near-maximal lengths.
title: Tight orthogonal arrays exclude nonbinary dimension-four length-maximal codes at defect \(q-1\)
